name: Lún Routte SE D45
positioning: Mixed-depth 46/54 mm road wheelset with a 21 mm inner width and published pressure caps.

rim.bead_note: The maker says reinforced carbon hooks improve tubeless tire compatibility.

max_pressure.note: Tubeless riding: 95 psi maximum; 30 mm tires 85 psi, 35 mm 60 psi and 40–45 mm 40 psi maximum.

load_limit.note: Rider, bike and luggage; riders above 90 kg should have the wheels inspected regularly.

weight.basis: Pair in black (1,715 g Chameleon); the specification table gives ±25 g per wheel.

hub: Model and engagement not published · steel bearings
warranty: 2-year wheelset warranty for the original buyer; wear parts are excluded.

price_observations.conditions: Same price for every finish and freehub; Chameleon with the Shimano freehub was sold out. Each regional warehouse ships only within its region, and the EU warehouse does not ship to the UK.
Shipping is calculated at checkout from Brazil, US, EU or China warehouses; each warehouse ships only within its own region.

caveats: Hub model and engagement are not published.
Keep to the size-specific pressure caps for wider tires.
Mainland China price not recorded; confirm it with an authorized seller.
